empty.title: No skills yet
empty.body: Create a skill or import one from a .md or .zip file, then attach it to agents.

selectPrompt.title: Select a skill
selectPrompt.body: Pick a skill on the left to edit it, preview what the agent receives, or browse its versions.

card.deleteConfirm: Delete skill "{name}"? Agents using it will lose it. This cannot be undone.

fields.name: Name
fields.descriptionPlaceholder: Flag every changed branch that no test exercises.
fields.descriptionHint: The skill's interface — write it as a directive: what the agent must check or flag.
fields.bodyHint: Saving a changed body creates a new immutable version.

import.hint: From a .zip only SKILL.md is read. Scripts and every other file are listed below but never read or run.
import.trustTitle: You are importing someone else's instructions
import.trustBody: Once enabled, this text goes into your agents' prompts as instructions. Read the body before you enable it — the skill is saved disabled.
import.success: Imported "{name}" — disabled until you read and enable it.

editor.untrustedNotice: This skill was imported. Its body becomes instructions in every agent it is attached to — read it before enabling.

preview.title: Preview
preview.subtitle: Rendered as the reviewing agent receives it.

versions.title: Version history
versions.subtitle: Every save of a changed body is snapshotted, so a run can be traced back to the exact text it used.
versions.restoreConfirm: Restore v{version}? Its body will be saved as a new version.
